overview: Fashion Nest is a real-time South Indian fashion e-commerce platform featuring traditional and contemporary clothing, jewelry, and accessories with INR pricing, Stripe payments, and a curated lookbook experience.
features: Product catalog with 40+ South Indian fashion items
New Arrivals, Women, Designers, Sale, and Accessories sections
Kanjivaram sarees, silk pattu sarees, half sarees, and traditional wear
Shopping cart with size/color variant selection
Admin panel for product and order management
Seasonal Lookbook with Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter collections
Responsive design with OKLCH warm cream color palette
